fit_card: Scored this adorable butterfly print Y2K baby tee on Depop for just $18 and I am obsessed. I’m living for the effortless Y2K street vibe paired with baggy dark wash denim, chunky sneakers, and a black denim jacket. Such an easy little top to throw on and instantly make an outfit.

Just scored this vintage cropped light wash denim jacket on Poshmark for only $42 and I'm obsessed! It’s the ultimate streetwear staple whether I'm styling it for a full Canadian tuxedo moment or layering it over a black hoodie and khakis. Safe to say this is going to be my new daily go-to jacket.

Score these chunky white platform sneakers on Poshmark for just $48 and I am never taking them off. They add the absolute best 90s streetwear height to baggy jeans and an oversized grey crewneck. Can't wait to style them with wide-leg khakis for that ultimate Y2K contrast look, too!

Scored this absolute dream of a Y2K butterfly baby tee on Depop for just $18 and I am never taking it off. It’s giving major early-2000s streetwear energy when I pair it with baggy dark wash jeans and chunky sneakers, but I'm just as obsessed with styling it against wide-leg khakis and combat boots. My closet has officially peaked.

Scored these low-rise khaki cargo pants on Poshmark for only $27 and I am obsessed. Total early 2000s off-duty energy when I pair them with a zip hoodie and chunky sneakers. Can't wait to lean into the ultimate streetwear edge with combat boots and an oversized crewneck next!

Scored this bootleg 2003 tour tee on depop for just $24 and I'm obsessed. Already planning to wear it with baggy dark denim and chunky sneakers for the ultimate 90s streetwear vibe. Such a good addition to the rotation!

Scored this black mesh long-sleeve top on Depop for just $15 and I am so obsessed. It’s giving the ultimate grungy Y2K energy layered over a white ribbed tank with baggy jeans and combat boots. Can't wait to style it under an oversized crewneck with khaki trousers for that perfect contrast look!

Scored these vintage Levi's 501 jeans on Depop for just $38 and I am never taking them off. They have the absolute best lived-in medium wash for throwing on with a cropped zip hoodie and chunky sneakers for casual streetwear days. Can't wait to beat these up even more.

Just scored this chunky brown knit cardigan on Depop for only $35 and I am never taking it off! It’s giving the ultimate cozy cottagecore energy, whether I'm styling it oversized with earth-tone trousers or adding some edge with dark wash jeans and combat boots. My autumn wardrobe is officially complete.

Scored this red and black oversized flannel on thredUp for just $22, and it’s officially my new uniform. I'm obsessed with throwing it over a ribbed tank with baggy denim and combat boots for that effortless 90s grunge look. Seriously never taking this off.
